assertions.label: Fresh positively verified private core starts empty
Exact nonce sentinel belongs to the verified private core
Full sentinel generation and QA ownership verified
Private app uses the original verified core generation
No native layout/mod errors
The Mods panel lists the fixture mods and layout with their GitHub-style sources and the gate’s own layout as source unknown
Each fixture item shows its repository’s own preview.png as a thumbnail, cached by the helper
Check for updates finds the new upstream commit of QA clock and nothing else
Update shows the changed file and the added key before anything is written
Apply update writes the new files in place and the mounted QA clock hot-reloads to v2 without a restart
The update’s new key reaches keys.json and pressing it reaches QA clock
Update all applies the safe QA timer update and leaves QA notes, whose update conflicts with an edit, for a review
An update that changes a line the person edited stops with a conflict and writes nothing
Take theirs resolves the conflict and the update applies
A later update that drops the key removes it from keys.json, and pressing it no longer reaches QA clock
Disabling a mod the layout on screen uses is refused with that layout’s name
Disabling a mod another layout uses asks first, naming that layout, and moves nothing until confirmed
Disable moves QA timer out of mods/ and Enable brings back identical files
Uninstall says removed items are kept for 30 days, and Restore brings back identical files
Uninstalling the layout on screen is refused and its file stays
Herdr’s own items are listed as built in, with no actions
The Mods panel and the fixture mods produced zero native app errors
Scenario used real native input and captured a native frame

boundary: Task-owned GPUI app/core with PID-bound native input. Existing instances were not queried. Provider authentication is not proven.
